flashlight.name: Flashlight
flashlight.desc: An old hand torch. Press F to switch it on. Eats batteries.

flashlight_plus.name: Improved Flashlight
flashlight_plus.desc: A rewired torch with a wider, brighter beam that drains slower.

hammer.name: Hammer
hammer.desc: Needed to beat scrap into a repair kit at the workbench.

wrench.name: Wrench
wrench.desc: Heavy railway wrench. Needed for switch work and for making spare parts.

screwdriver.name: Screwdriver
screwdriver.desc: Opens service panels and fuse boxes.

crowbar.name: Crowbar
crowbar.desc: Forces jammed doors and nailed crates.

pliers.name: Pliers
pliers.desc: Needed to twist wire into fuses.

medkit.name: First Aid Kit
medkit.desc: Restores a large amount of health.

med_supplies.name: Medical Supplies
med_supplies.desc: Gauze, iodine and ampoules. Combine two into a first aid kit.

cloth.name: Cloth
cloth.desc: Clean rags. Two make a bandage at the medical station.

scrap.name: Scrap Metal
scrap.desc: Bent plates and offcuts. The base of most repairs.

engine_part.name: Engine Part
engine_part.desc: A locomotive engine component. Restores a lot of engine condition.

battery.name: Battery
battery.desc: Recharges a flashlight (R) or tops up the train's electrics at the fuse box.

fuel.name: Fuel Can
fuel.desc: Coal oil for the firebox. Also runs generators.

fuse.name: Fuse
fuse.desc: Restores a dead circuit: the train's fuse box, a generator, a signal.

bolts.name: Bolts
bolts.desc: A handful of rusty bolts and nuts.

electronics.name: Electronic Components
electronics.desc: Valves, coils and capacitors. Two make a battery.

spare_part.name: Spare Part
spare_part.desc: A fitted part for the brakes and running gear.

repair_kit.name: Repair Kit
repair_kit.desc: Patches the engine or the running gear.

key_warehouse.name: Warehouse Key
key_warehouse.desc: A brass key stamped RAVENWOOD GOODS.

key_records.name: Records Room Key
key_records.desc: A steel key on a conductor's chain.

map.name: Route Map
map.desc: Northern Vale Railway, 1961. The line ends at Hollowgate. Use it to read the route.

radio.name: Radio Receiver
radio.desc: A valve receiver. Use it to listen. Something is still broadcasting.

switch_lever.name: Switch Lever
switch_lever.desc: The throw lever of a railway switch.

switch_rod.name: Switch Rod
switch_rod.desc: The connecting rod of a railway switch.

valve_wheel.name: Valve Wheel
valve_wheel.desc: A red hand wheel from a gate hydraulic valve.

gate_gear.name: Gate Gear
gate_gear.desc: A heavy toothed gear from a tunnel gate winch.
